name: taurine

otcwarn: WARNINGS: ​If pregnant or breast-feeding, ​ ask a health care professional before use. ​Keep out of reach of children. ​ In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. Do not use if tamper evident seal is broken or missing. Store in a cool, dry place.
